content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS/Any other Medical Graduate with post-graduation in Pediatrics (MD/DNB/DCH) Age limit: Maximum 40 years Other conditions: Highly proficient in MS office and well versed with handling large data sets. Command over statistical software package like SPSS/SATA/CSPro/DevInfo/Epi info. Ability to make oral and written presentations on technical issues. Good command over English and Hindi language. Desirable: Reports writing experience preferred.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur State Newborn Care Quality Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: In consultation with QI newborn and Child health project team, Consultant needs to perform following duties: Contribute in State newborn AMR consortium as per need and suggested by supervisor. Facilitate for Data Collection, Compilation, Analysis and review related to project area. Regular coordination with District teams to promote the quality and timely data support. Field level Supportive supervision/ hand holding to ensure timely and standard data-based operations, as per project need. Do daily teleround of IOSNCU. Help the P.I. in condition of trainings on Q.I, ETAT/HDU and newborn Care and any other work assigned by P.I. Analyze the data, identify the gaps and facilitate for implementation of suggestive inputs so as to get the optimum quality data outputs. Coordination with different stakeholders for implementation of project interventions. Any other task assigned by supervisor/Technical reporting person.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Fixed tenure of 02 months and extendible 1 year or more on contractual basis. Employment will automatically terminate upon completion of 02 months from the day of joining.
